extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, and researchers interested in Vietnam War history and media controversies
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic Wikipedia article summarizing Operation Tailwind (a 1970 covert MACV‑SOG incursion into Laos), its conduct and casualties, and the later 1998 CNN/Time 'Valley of Death' investigative report, subsequent investigations, retractions, and litigation. Provides historical narrative, sources, and external links.
